“내가 피를 볼 때에 너희를 넘어가리니”: “when I see the blood, I will pass over you”
“이스라엘 자손이 바다 가운데를 육지로 걸어가고”: “the people of Israel went into the midst of the sea on dry ground”
육지로 걸어가고”: the midst of the sea on dry ground”
“물은 그들의 좌우에 벽이 되니”:
“the waters being a wall to them
on their right hand and on their left”
